scripts.api-types: uv --directory apps/api run python -m app.openapi ../../libs/shared/openapi.json && openapi-typescript libs/shared/openapi.json -o libs/shared/src/api-types.ts
scripts.build: corepack pnpm exec vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm exec eslint . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff check && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm exec tsc --build libs/shared/tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json && uv --directory apps/api run mypy
scripts.test:hooks: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: corepack pnpm exec playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run api-types && corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test:imports && corepack pnpm run test:api && corepack pnpm run test:hooks && corepack pnpm run test:browser
